intro.summary: North-central community between 4 Street NW and Edmonton Trail north of 32 Avenue, with a grid of older homes and ongoing semi-detached infill.
intro.body: Highland Park lies north of 32 Avenue N between 4 Street NW and Edmonton Trail, with McKnight Boulevard to the north and Centre Street N running through it. Its post-war homes on regular lots have seen a steady stream of single-detached and semi-detached infills.
